title: GDN Tree-Scan: Served Tree Verification for Recurrent-Hybrid Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tree speculative decoding verifies multiple candidate continuations in one target forward pass. For attention-only transformers, the verifier mainly needs an ancestry mask. Recurrent-hybrid language models break this assumption: a candidate row must also carry the recurrent state that native sequential decode would have produced along its root-to-node path. Otherwise, a verifier can use a correct attention mask while still conditioning on an impossible recurrent history.   We present GDN Tree-Scan, a served verifier for Gated-DeltaNet hybrid language models integrated into vLLM. The system combines FlashAttention-2 tree-bias attention, branch-local GDN scan/replay, device-side multidraft commitment, and accepted-chain-only state publication. On the public Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 checkpoint, in a clean batch-one (B=1) SWE/Codex decode gate at temperature 0.6, a six-node root-branch tree increases committed tokens/event by 17.2% at near-native ver

translated_title: GDN Tree-Scan：面向循环-混合语言模型的服务化树式验证
translated_abstract: 树式投机解码可在一次目标模型前向传播中验证多个候选续写序列。对于仅含注意力的Transformer，验证器主要只需一个祖先关系掩码。而循环-混合语言模型打破了这一假设：每个候选行还必须携带原生顺序解码沿其从根到节点路径所产生的循环状态。否则，验证器即使使用了正确的注意力掩码，仍可能基于不可能出现的循环历史进行条件计算。我们提出了GDN Tree-Scan，一个集成到vLLM中的、面向Gated-DeltaNet混合语言模型的服务化验证器。该系统结合了FlashAttention-2树偏置注意力、分支局部的GDN扫描/重放、设备端多草稿提交，以及仅发布被接受链的状态。在公开的Qwen3.6-27B-FP8检查点上，在温度0.6的干净批大小为1（B=1）的SWE/Codex解码门控测试中，六节点的根分支树使每次事件提交的token数提升了17.2%，同时验证开销接近原生水平。
tldr: 提出了GDN Tree-Scan——一个集成到vLLM的面向Gated-DeltaNet循环-混合语言模型的树式投机解码验证器，通过在树验证中正确重建各分支路径上的循环状态，在Qwen3.6-27B-FP8上将每次事件提交的token数提升17.2%，且验证开销接近原生。
en_tdlr: GDN Tree-Scan is a served tree speculative decoding verifier for Gated-DeltaNet recurrent-hybrid language models integrated into vLLM, which correctly reconstructs recurrent states along root-to-node paths, increasing committed tokens per event by 17.2% on Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 at near-native verification cost.
